question: What stirring clearly manifests the form of the power of action?
premises: A mutual stirring arises in the unfolding of will.
This stirring clearly manifests the form of the power of action.
inference: The mutual stirring within the unfolding of will is the clear expression of kriya-shakti.
uncertainties: The phrase tadgaterapi is compressed and its exact syntactic link is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: The mutual stirring that arises in the unfolding of will clearly manifests the form of the power of action, and it is also said to belong to that movement.
